settings.tab_content: Grown under structural shade cloths for 20 days prior to harvest, stimulating chlorophyl and amino acid production.
Slow ground on traditional granite stone mills at 30 RPM to preserve nutrients and delicate organic notes.
Whisk 2g of matcha with 70ml of hot water (80°C/176°F) using a bamboo chasen until a thick jade froth forms.
Sourced directly from organic micro-farms in Uji, Kyoto Prefecture. Lab verified zero heavy metals or pesticides.
